ops.text: (c) In addition, Company may terminate this Agreement or any Statement of Work for convenience, in whole or in part and for any or no reason, upon thirty (30) (30) days advance written notice to Contractor, without penalty, early-termination charge or forfeiture of any amounts. Upon any such termination, Contractor will be paid all fees and expenses incurred or earned for Services properly performed through the effective date of such termination, Contractor shall refund to Company any prepaid fees for the period after such effective date, and Contractor shall provide to Company, and hereby assigns to Company, all right, title and interest to any Works in progress.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have added a Company right to terminate this Agreement or any Statement of Work for convenience on 30 days' notice, since Section 6(a) allows convenience termination only when no Statement of Work is outstanding, leaving us unable to exit an in-flight engagement of indefinite duration. Our playbook requires a customer convenience right on 30 days' notice with payment limited to Services performed and a refund of prepaid amounts; we can discuss 60 days' notice as a fallback.
input.summary: Add Company termination-for-convenience right on 30 days' notice covering outstanding Statements of Work, with no penalty and refund of prepaid fees.
